meta.description: News coverage (race profiles, candidate profiles, interviews, guides) from the Winnipeg Free Press and CBC Manitoba for each 2026 Winnipeg contest, keyed by the We Address tool's contest slug.
meta.candidate_ids: City of Winnipeg Open Data dataset 9gi9-dauz `id` field; name_official is that dataset's `name` field.

kinds.race_profile: An article or video about this ward race as a whole.
kinds.race_guide: Mayor only: a page covering every mayoral candidate (interview collection, platform tracker).
kinds.candidate_profile: A piece focused on one candidate in this contest.
kinds.candidate_interview: Mayor only: a one-on-one interview video with one candidate.
kinds.all_wards_roundup: A piece covering all 15 council races; it applies to every ward but gives each one only a few paragraphs.

meta.school_trustees: School trustee contests are intentionally empty: coverage was too sparse (one candidate profile across 18 contested races) to show without singling out a candidate.
meta.sort: Within each contest, items are pre-sorted: race-level items first, then candidate items, then roundups; newest first within each group.
